points.point: Why scheduling a LinkedIn post 3 weeks out gives 'too far in the future' (in app and API)
Scheduling limit that applies to this date (9 months)
points.sentence: The furthest date in the future you can schedule a post for is 9 months on every plan.

verdict.reason: The entry states the 9-month limit, but the customer's date is only three weeks out, so the entry does not explain why the error occurs, and answering would require a guess about their account.
